species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 52°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 6–20 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 80 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 115 ft, so fish stay above it.
South wind at 23 mph pushes bait onto the north shore: try the wind-blown banks.
